chunks: And by his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
I am leaving among you two weighty things: the Book of Allah and my 'Itra (Progeny), and they will not separate from each other until they meet at the Pool (of Kawthar).
ai.seo_question: What are the two weighty things the Prophet left behind according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This foundational Hadith al-Thaqalayn, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, establishes the dual authority of the Quran and the Ahl al-Bayt as inseparable guides who will not diverge until they meet at the Prophet's Pool (Al-Kawthar). In Shia scholarship, this emphasizes that true understanding of the Quran is inextricably linked to the interpretation and guidance of the Imams, ensuring the preservation of divine truth. The promise of their reunion at the Hawd underscores their eternal unity in leading the faithful to salvation.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-259 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.), the Prophet (S) said,
“I leave two important things with you - God’s Book and my ‘Itra. They will not separate from each other until they return to me at the Pool.”
